scope: User-authorized six-metric descriptive evaluation of the existing CP01 pair only
text_policy: Submit unchanged full generation prompt; preserve native ViCLIP 32-token truncation and expose the effective text. Do not silently summarize. This score cannot evaluate the full complex instructions.
report_policy: 12 per-video scores and 6 descriptive T50-minus-S4 differences; no confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, total score, or qualification conclusion. dynamic_degree is a binary motion flag, not a higher-is-better quality score.
data_scope: Separate exploratory batch; do not pool with S2/S2-R official-domain qualification.
user_observation: User informally observed better instruction adherence for the student and difficulty judging overall preference. This is not a collected human rating.
